description: The user's Webotee plan and usage: plan and price, subscription status and renewal or end date, AI Connect calls used today against the plan's daily limit, today's use of the live tools (live offers, live product refreshes, live searches, best-seller lists, cross-web checks), and how much of this month's live-data allowance is used. Use when the user asks about their plan, limits, remaining calls or why a live tool was paused.
